details.description: Figo Moow is a liquid roller pen with smooth, quick-drying blue ink and a fine tip, sold as a pack of 10 pens in cute printed bodies.
details.usageInstructions: Remove the cap and write. Replace the cap after use.
details.dangerWarnings: For writing only. Keep the cap on when not in use and keep away from small children.

details.description: Figo A9 Liquid Roller Pen has a 0.6mm metal pipe tip and a liquid ink system for smooth, skip-free writing with a comfortable grip. Pack of 7 blue pens.
details.usageInstructions: Remove the cap and write. Replace the cap after use.
details.dangerWarnings: For writing only. Keep the cap on when not in use and keep away from small children.

details.description: Figo Aeroclick is a retractable roller gel pen with blue ink in pastel bodies. Pack of 10 pens.

details.description: Figo Longer Jumbo ink cartridges hold more ink than standard cartridges. Each pack has 10 boxes of 3 blue cartridges for fountain pens.
details.usageInstructions: Unscrew the pen barrel, press the cartridge onto the nib section until it clicks, and write.
details.dangerWarnings: Ink stains clothes. Keep away from small children.
